plan.notes: Kirkwood Community College 2025-2026 official Business Administration A.A.S. plan (Transfer Track), program total 65 credits; term sums match exactly. The program prepares students for transfer (University of Iowa Tippie College of Business, Mount Mercy, Coe) or direct workforce entry. Term 2 choice slots list the catalog's published alternatives (ENG-108 or ENG-106; PHI-105 or PHI-135; SPC-101 or SPC-112; MAT-165 or MAT-163). Footnote 1: transfer-track courses should be selected from the approved list for the student's transfer institution (see advisor). BUS-294 Business Admin Capstone (1 cr) must be taken in the final term with permission. Approved Social Science/Humanities/Science/Literature courses per Kirkwood's AAS degree requirements.
